title: Rockefeller serves breakfast and vows to get disclosure
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Rockefeller serves breakfast and vows to get disclosure, about 1990s at Rockefeller's house, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Rockefeller goes he he's talking Bud Hopkins told me a story he's there Jacobs and him are at uh him and Mack are at uh Rockefeller's house And Rockefeller is like a butler and he's taking bringing him breakfast and stuff like that. And they thought this is kind of weird this billionaires, you know, feeding us breakfast and stuff. And he he said, "I'm going to I'm going to get disclosure."

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, passes on a story he heard from Budd Hopkins, a man who studied people who said aliens had taken them. Hopkins said that in the 1990s he and two fellow researchers, David Jacobs and John Mack, went to the house of the billionaire Laurence Rockefeller, who served them breakfast like a butler and told them, "I'm going to get disclosure," meaning an official release of what the government knows about UFOs. If true, it would show a very rich and well-connected man personally pushing for that release.
